== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Ancestor's [[Tomb]] is an ancient, massive square mausoleum located at the edge of a mountainside in [[Sacred Valley]]. Predating the [[Heaven’s Glory School|Heaven's Glory School]] by many centuries, the structure is a monumental edifice built upon enormous pillars and is significantly larger than any building within the school itself. The exterior features a prominent [[mural]] of four legendary beasts, and its walls are inscribed with deep, ancient [[scripts]] designed to collect [[vital aura]] over long periods of time. The interior of the tomb is a vast, open space characterized by numerous pillars and murals depicting four [[sacred beasts]]: a lightning-streaked blue serpentine [[dragon]], a crowned white tiger, a tortoise-shelled [[stone]] warrior, and a blazing red phoenix. This four-part symbol is also found on an ornate door at the back of the main hall, which is believed to serve as the entrance to a complex [[labyrinth]] or the actual burial site. This [[labyrinth]] is considered one of the oldest locations in the world and may be linked to the birthplace of the [[Dreadgods]]. The tomb has served various roles throughout history, acting as a place of refuge during attacks and housing significant legacies, such as the [[Soulsmithing]] knowledge left by [[Ozmanthus Arelius]].}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Predating the [[Heaven’s Glory School|Heaven's Glory School]] by unknown centuries, the Ancestor's [[Tomb]] is a massive square mausoleum supported by vast pillars. The structure features deep, ancient [[scripts]] designed to gather [[vital aura]] and is decorated with murals of four gigantic beasts locked in battle found above the entrance and on the ceiling. As [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] streak toward this site of past battles, a sudden collapse occurs after [[Yerin]] slices one of the pillars. The [[destruction]] is marked by [[Lindon]]'s scream echoing through every corner before [[Anses]] begins picking through the resulting ruins.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Ancestor's [[Tomb]] is a location situated along the travel route. Protected by a [[Script|script]], the structure features an entrance adorned with a [[mural]] depicting the four [[Dreadgods]]. While the interior consists of a wide-open space lined with pillars, the site sustained damage during the attack by the [[Wandering Titan]]. This assault left the tomb with a cracked pillar and a caved-in roof.}}
